speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with a breast mass; to help me evaluate this, please tell me how long you have noticed the lump and if it has changed in size or shape. Additionally, is the mass painful, and have you noticed any changes in your skin or nipple discharge?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Breast Cancer.

The patient is a 48-year-old woman presenting with a rapidly enlarging, painless left breast mass over four weeks. This clinical picture is highly suspicious for malignancy. Please confirm if you have noticed any skin changes, nipple retraction, or axillary lymphadenopathy. If the patient confirms these findings or denies them, I will proceed to order a diagnostic mammogram and ultrasound immediately.
